item.body:
### Summary
The captures of #301 and #134 (PR #435) show that the LOT-056 image host table marks hosts http-only that serve https, and that `reho.st` gates on the `Referer`: align `ImageHostTable` and its tests with the captures.

### Facts (HFR-PROTOCOL §6c LOT-056, §7 E26, captures `T10`-`T24`)
- `si1.photorapide.com`: https 200 `image/jpeg` (`T13`) → not http-only.
- `www.camif.fr`: https answers (404 old file, `T14`), http 301 → https (`T14h`) → not http-only.
- `yelims.free.fr`: TCP refused on 443 (`T11`), http 200 (`T11h`) → http-only (keep).
- `nsa34.casimages.com`, `img15.hostingpics.net`, `bibi.hn.org`: no DNS answer (`T10`, `T12`, `T15`): neither scheme works; keep or mark as observed-dead, but do not claim http-only from evidence.
- `reho.st`: 403 without `Referer`, 200 with `https://forum.hardware.fr/` or `https://forum.hardware.fr` (`T20`-`T24`): the table's legacy value is accepted; a real image with the Referer is not observed.

### Files to touch
- `Packages/HFRKit/Sources/HFRNetwork/ImageHosts/ImageHostTable.swift` (`observedHTTPOnly` rows), `ImageHostRule.swift` doc if needed.
- `Packages/HFRKit/Tests/HFRNetworkTests/ImageHosts/ImageHostTableTests.swift`: a test per row citing the capture id (read the `T*.meta.json` status where useful).
- `docs/lots/LOT-056-image-hosts.md` "Pending capture" items; LOT-083 App Transport Security note if it lists these hosts.

### Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Each host row cites its capture; tests green on Linux and macOS.
- [ ] No HFR fact without a capture id.
